formula: float32 * factors * (3 * n_users + (16 frequency + 2 item factors + 16 thread deltas + 1 master reduction) * n_items)
limitations: Static allocation lower bound, not measured peak RSS. Excludes native datasets, indices, user/day biases, allocator overhead, temporary vectors, other workers and OS.
Source low_memory=true disables per-user/day factor/cache matrices. Do NOT incorrectly add the large daily matrix used by the currently running ordinal temporal model.
Configured16 logical chunks retain16 delta matrices even when Rayon has fewer active threads.
Original first-epoch sequential recipes defer the delta allocation; later parallel epochs still need it.

Current serial mapped backend maps the three user-factor/cache matrices but leaves large item-frequency and thread-delta matrices on the heap; high-capacity parallel presets need additional verification/storage work.
policy: Preserve source factors, epochs, chunks and arithmetic. Before later primary queue reaches unsafe concurrent allocations, use a separately versioned scheduler/storage plan; do not edit the active frozen primary source runner or downscale recipes silently.
